findings.claim: The atomic preflight can diverge from the live processor because it stores the caller-supplied catalog array by reference while the live processor was initialized from a snapshot.
findings.evidence: The constructor assigns `this.catalogs = catalogs;` but initializes the live processor with `new OfficialMessageProcessor([...catalogs], ...)`; `preflight()` later builds its shadow processor from `[...this.catalogs]`. This contradicts the new package README claim that `processMessages()` preflights the complete batch so later errors cannot partially commit earlier messages.
findings.suggested_fix: Create one immutable catalog snapshot in the constructor, use that same snapshot for both `this.catalogs` and the live `OfficialMessageProcessor`, and do not retain the caller-owned array reference.
